priceSpecification.description: Starting price; customized flat monthly proposal.

mainEntity.name: Does Stellar work with small and boutique condominium associations?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Stellar provides full-service association management for small Chicago condo buildings and vintage conversions as well as larger communities. The service is for condominium associations, not rental apartments.

mainEntity.name: Can a small association afford professional management?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pricing starts at $20 per unit per month, with a customized flat monthly proposal based on the actual scope. The board can compare the fee with the time, continuity, reporting, collections, vendor, maintenance, and compliance responsibilities currently carried by volunteers.

mainEntity.name: What problems does management solve for a self-managed condo?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professional management replaces scattered inboxes, spreadsheets, and verbal handoffs with board-ready financials, owner ledgers, insured-vendor records, meeting and decision documentation, a maintenance calendar, consistent communications, and records that survive board turnover.

mainEntity.name: Will the board still control decisions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The board retains its governing authority. Stellar organizes information, carries out authorized work, tracks deadlines, and gives directors a dependable operating system so they can make and document decisions more effectively.

mainEntity.name: How does a small association transition to Stellar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Onboarding begins with a records inventory and a 30–60 day handoff covering governing documents, banking, owner balances, contracts, insurance, tax and corporate records, minutes, warranties, keys, open issues, and planned work.
